The quantum query complexity of the maximum flow problem in graphs with unit capacity is O(min{n3/2 m1/4 , n11/6 }), where n and m are the number of vertices and edges in the graph, respectively. It is an open question whether a similar result for maximum matching in a general nonbipartite graph can be proven, perhaps by applying Theorem 5.2 to the classical algorithm of Micali and Vazirani [35]. 7 Projective query complexity We end this paper with a brief discussion on another query complexity model, which we will call the projective query complexity.
